title: Tribes critical logarithmic limits
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $m_w$ be the greatest natural number $s\le 2^{w+2}$ for which $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le \tfrac12$, taking $m_w=0$ if there is no such $s$. Set $D_w=m_w w$ and $E_w=w-\bigl(\log_2 D_w-\log_2(\log D_w)\bigr)$. As $w\to\infty$, both $\frac{\log D_w}{w\log 2}\to 1$ and $E_w\to 0$.
